title: Собрать trusted private-RC workflow и aggregate verification receipt
summary: Оркестрировать trusted private RC без public side effects и выпустить один digest-qualified receipt, который P10 может проверить независимо.
why: Зелёные child jobs не доказывают, что один candidate собран из тех же inputs и subjects; hosted capability также нельзя подменять локальной симуляцией.

include: Trusted `private-rc` workflow; manual/protected-ref guards; isolated build, verify and optional attest jobs; minimum job permissions; exact P8 `release-candidate` tier; P9.2 CI map; P9.3 reproducibility; P9.4 SBOM/provenance/capability states; bounded artifact retention; independent download/re-hash verification; aggregate exact-set receipt and human finding.
exclude: Automatic push/dispatch from local execution; GitHub setting/secret/environment changes; tag/release/registry upload; public semver/license approval; accepting missing hosted evidence as present; rebuilding from lowest/latest matrix locks; changing child evidence.

rules: Workflow starts at `permissions: {}`, runs only on explicit manual invocation and/or trusted protected refs defined by contract, and never executes fork/untrusted code or consumes untrusted caches/artifacts. Build/verify jobs receive `contents: read` only; only the conditional attest job receives `id-token: write` and `attestations: write`. Local execution always assembles and independently verifies subjects/SBOM/provenance/child receipts; it records hosted state as `not-executed` or capability-specific status. Platform artifact ID/digest proves transport, not release identity. Aggregate receipt enumerates exact child IDs/digests, subjects, checksums, matrices, P8 rows, tool lock, source/tree and capability states with no inferred pass.
guidance: Verify after downloading into a fresh directory and before optional attestation. Use fail-closed exact-set joins and refuse stale source SHA, mixed run IDs, missing subjects or duplicate identities. Model `local_rc` and `hosted_attestation` as separate state machines. Static workflow tests must prove there is no tag/release/package-write path. Keep logs/artifact names free of secrets and set finite timeout/retention/concurrency.
deliverables: Hardened private-RC workflow, independent verifier, exact aggregate P9 receipt and explicit hosted-capability finding ready for P10 acceptance.

sections.title: Validation
sections.text: Policy checker and malicious workflow fixtures prove least privilege, trusted trigger/ref, no untrusted transition and no public write scope; fresh local assembly plus independent verification produces exact aggregate with `missing=[]`, `extra=[]`, `stale=[]`; mutation of any child/subject/tool/source digest turns red; all applicable critical P8 RC rows are present; hosted status accurately distinguishes verified/unavailable/not-executed; when hosted attestation is available, downloaded bundle verifies against exact subject digests; workflow has no registry/tag/release command and requires no publication credentials; plan lint adds no ERROR.
